steps.en: Clone, install dependencies and start the development server
steps.zh: 克隆、安装依赖并启动开发服务

steps.en: Adapt an example's HTML, JavaScript, copy and model references
steps.zh: 改写示例页面、脚本、文案和模型引用

steps.en: Open that example and interact with its page
steps.zh: 打开该示例并操作页面

steps.en: Loads models with shared decoding, caching and progress
steps.zh: 统一解码、缓存模型并报告加载进度

steps.en: Renders the adapted scene while its input and scroll callbacks update it
steps.zh: 渲染改写的场景，并由输入和滚动回调更新

value.en: An editable 3D website without rebuilding its render stack and loaders
value.zh: 得到可编辑三维网站，不必重搭渲染栈与加载器
